scope: Synthetic native grammar/TokenIterator/raw producer tests on an Apple Silicon Mac, plus an arm64 iOS package Release compilation. No model inference or App/device acceptance.

nativeGrammarDependency.languageRuntime: Swift and statically compiled native C++

iOSPackageCompile.command: swift build --package-path Apple/Packages/QwenNative -c release --disable-automatic-resolution --triple arm64-apple-ios26.0 --sdk /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/iPhoneOS.platform/Developer/SDKs/iPhoneOS27.2.sdk --target QwenNative

preservedProductionBehavior: Single-turn Direct TokenIterator and generateTokenTask producer
Cancel producer, await producer, synchronize Metal stream before returning
Local model and native tokenizer loading
No embedded Python/JavaScript runtime or generated code execution

apiChanges.optionalArgument: jsonSchema: String? = nil on generateJSON and generateJSONDirect
apiChanges.completionCallback: onCompletion(QwenGenerationCompletion), appended after existing progress callback parameters
apiChanges.stopSemantics: SDK stop means EOS or unknown token; raw generation does not claim confirmed EOS.
apiChanges.outputLimitSemantics: Direct may return a diagnostic partial string and reports the SDK length termination. Formal generateJSON rejects length termination with QwenError.outputLimit.
apiChanges.contentLogging: No prompt, response, token ID or chain-of-thought content in runtime stage/progress/completion callbacks.

sdkLimitations.limitation: Public GrammarConstraint.clone() is not implemented by the pinned native fork shim.
sdkLimitations.implementation: A pristine matcher is handed off once; later requests recompile independently. Processor copies rebuild and replay accepted tokens. Mutable matcher and failure state are never shared.

sdkLimitations.limitation: Bounded number grammar uses six decimal places and excludes scientific notation; valid native Float snapshots can be rejected.
sdkLimitations.implementation: At grammar compilation only, remove minimum/maximum/exclusiveMinimum/exclusiveMaximum only from schema nodes whose type is exactly number. Preserve authoritative source schema, integer bounds, cardinalities, patterns, required fields and extra-property rules. Do not traverse literal const/enum/default payloads.
sdkLimitations.numericValidationOwner: ScenePlan/SceneSpec must strictly validate decoded numeric bounds before geometry or save. Negative lathe radius and 4.5m height are accepted as number syntax but rejected by Core in these tests.
sdkLimitations.provenance: Completion metadata contains original and compiled schema SHA256 plus floatBoundsCheckedAfterDecoding=true.

sdkLimitations.limitation: Native compiler enforces schema property order rather than every semantically equivalent JSON key order.
sdkLimitations.implementation: Generated output follows schema property order. Canonical sorted-key ScenePlan snapshots match it; node array order remains unrestricted, including child before parent.

coveredContractFixtures: Child node preceding its parent node
Negative lathe radius and out-of-range height rejected by Core after grammar acceptance
